description: This Kotlin source file defines the Application subclass 'App' for an Android app. It initializes secure token storage using EncryptedSharedPreferences, sets up local data sources for offline use, and ensures ApiClient is initialized for configuration purposes. The class also provides a static method for retrieving a safe application context.
